tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bod khams bde thabs chos bcu yi: bstan pa srung ba'i skor bzhi las: gshin rje 'jigs byed rol pa bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ 'gro ba spyi dang bod 'bangs kyi: skyabs gcig o rgyan rje la 'dud: yang cig lha sras bdag nyid kyis: gu ru rje la gsol btab pa: ma 'ongs sum cu kha ral la: bod khams sdug bsngal la spyod cing: bstan pa nyams shing 'jig pa na: bar chad rkyen gyi sna khrid bgegs: bstan pa'i dgra bo bsgral ba'i phyir: thabs dang man ngag ci bgyi zhus: gu ru rje yis bka' bstsal pa: sangs rgyas bstan pa la sdang ba: nyams pa bdun ldan bsgral ba dang: byad ma rbod gtong zlog pa dang: phyi pa'i ngan sngags 'phrul 'khor bshig: bar chad bgegs rkyen tshar gcad cing: chag chen ngan pa bzlog pa'i phyir: dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed rol pa la bsten nas: byang chub sgrub cing srung zlog gsad: sgrub dang las sbyor 'di ltar bya: dpa' bo 'jam dpal skyabs su gzung: byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs gzhom zhing: 'gro la phan dang bde ba bsgrub: bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed do: snod bcud kun tu gzigs kyi zhing: bdag nyid 'jam dpal ye shes sems: dmar gsal ral gri pusti 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: skyil krung pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyis bskor: oṃ wā gī shwa ra muṃ: de nyid gnas 'gyur gshin rje'i gshed: mthing nag dbyug to 'khor lo 'dzin: oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: snod bcud gshin rje rol pa'i zhing: sku las sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'phros: 'byung po gdon gyi tshogs rnams la: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon sbyin: khro chung dbyug to thogs pa yis: bar chad bgegs rnams thams cad gzhom: phyag mtshan 'khor lo rdul ltar 'tshubs: kun kyang gnam lcags zhun du 'dril: snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur 'bar: mtshon cha'i bu yug me rlung 'tshubs: sus kyang gzhom gzhig med pa'i nang: dur khrod rol pa'i sa gzhi la: dregs pa brtsegs pa'i zhal yas khang: yi dwags glang rgod bsnol ba'i khrir:

padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: dpal chen 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed: mun pa 'khyil ba'i mdog lta bu: rtsa zhal ma he khros pa yi: rwa la ye shes me chen 'bar: mthing ser dmar ljang dbu lnga la: spyan ni bco lnga nyi ltar 'bar: stobs bcu rdzogs pa'i phyag bcu yis: gri gug 'khor lo rdo rje dang: be con ral gri g.yas na 'dzin: thod khrag lcags kyu gtun shing dang: dgra st+wa mdung thung g.yon na bsnams: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bdud bzhi brdzis: sbyor ba'i yum mchog bai tā li: dgra st+wa thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud: spu gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa gdengs: thod skam 'bar bas dbu la brgyan: glang chen zhing lpags stod du gsol: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mdzad: thod phreng do shal rus rgyan drug: sbrul rigs lnga yi chas gsol nas: khrag zhags thal bas byugs nas su: gar dgu dpal gyi rol pas 'gying: sgrol yum e ka dzā ṭi ma: smug nag spu gri mi snying bsnams: phyogs bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la: ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar: ma ru tse dang ral pa dgu: mthing ser dmar ljang zhal gsum ldan: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum dang bcas: 'bar ba'i gzhal yas bar khyams su: nag 'joms phya sang brag 'joms dang: a ba glang mgo ya ba ti: mig dmar tel pa rmigs pa dang: chos rgyal 'bar ba thod dbyug can: 'chi bdag bcu gnyis yum dang bcas: sgo bzhir rgod dang stag gi mgo: kaṅka lcags spyang gdong can rnams: mu ran gri thogs ging chen bzhi: mdung dar thogs pa'i bdud chen bzhi: shwa thogs rtsis bzhi shan pa bzhi: gzhan yang ma gshin sprul pa'i 'khor: 'jam dpal nyid kyi rtsal las snang: hūm̐: mgon po kun gzigs zhing khams nas: 'jam dpal dpa' bo spyan 'dren no: gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba: 'jigs byed rol pa gshin rje'i gshed: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol:

oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i lha: rang la gnyis su med par thim: 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lha: nam mkhar byon nas byang sems kyis: ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur zhing: sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med mdzad: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i mchod pa sprin ltar gtibs: dbang po'i me tog gsur chen dud pa'i sprin: bskal pa'i me phung khrag chen rba klong 'khrugs: rkang gi dung chen thod rnga 'brug ltar ldir: sha chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa la: rakta'i rgya mtsho bdud rtsis bran pa rnams: gshin rje'i lha tshogs dgyes pa chen pos rol: ma hā puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda ba liṃ ta rakta pū dza ho: hūm̐: stobs bcu yongs rdzogs 'jam dpal bdud kyi dgra: 'jigs byed zhal la rngam pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog: mi g.yo thugs mnga' gtum rngams sgrol ba'i las: thogs med yon tan phrin las rdzogs la bstod: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yab ni kun tu bzang po ste: yum ni kun tu bzang mo yin: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: mkhyen rab kun gyi bdag po ste: thabs mkhas kun gyi rgyal po yin: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs 'dus: mthu rtsal nga las che ba med: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi rje: khams gsum kun la nga nyid che: nga yi gzi brjid mthong bas na: khro rgyal gzhan rnams dpa' zhum nas: lag cha 'chor nas gzhan du 'bros: dregs can thams cad brgyal gyur nas: dgra dang bgegs rnams phye mar brlag: gsal brtan nga rgyal bzung byas nas: oṃ hrīḥṣṭiḥbī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa: gyad du gyur nas drag sngags bzla: skad cig ting 'dzin gsal yang rung: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra ya kṣe ya yakṣe yatstsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

drag sngags 'di nyid bzlas tsam gyis: chag chen ngan pa kun zlog cing: nyi ma bzhi la bzlas pa yis: byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs rnams bsgral: log par 'dren pa'i dgra rnams 'chi: nyams pa bdun ldan bsgral pa yis: bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs nas kyang: sku ni gsal bar bsgom pa yis: 'jam dpal sku dang gnyis su med: gsal brtan gyad du gyur pa yis: snang ba lha ru dag nas kyang: 'jam dpal sku yi grub mtha' ste: byang chub sgrub pa'i rim pa 'o: sa ma ya: dang po srung ba'i rim pa ni: rgyas par stobs chen mchod rten bzhengs: bsdu na pu ri bca' ba 'am: dar ram shog bu gtsang ma la: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bcu drug dang: mu khyud gsum ldan bris pa'i nang: dbus su gang bsrung ming spel ba: bsgrub bya yul 'khor gtsug lag khang lta bu'i gzugs dang ming spel ba gang 'byor: de la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: 'khor lo rnams la grong khyer bkod: 'bru gnyis re: mu khyud dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying: bkod la rdo rwa me ris bskor: gang bsrung rakṣa la sogs spel: lha dang dbyer med rab gnas bya: sgrub tshe bdag dang dbyer med du: bdag nyid 'jam dpal he ru ka: spyi bor 'khor lo dkar por oṃ: mgrin par padma dmar por ā: thugs kar mchod rten nang du hūm̐: bar khyams 'khor yug thams cad du: dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa bla ma dang mched grogs dam tshig gtsang ma thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang la: tshud: kun kyang lha dang gzhal yas khang: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa: mar rtse phur pa'i dbal lta bu: dgra bgegs bdud bzhi'i snying la gzir: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: padma rgya gram ral gri dang: sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i gur: sprul pa'i khro tshogs mang po yis: srung ba'i las rnams mdzad par gyur: zhal nang du gzigs pa: lha tshogs rnams kyis srung ba'i sngags: 'brug stong ldir ba lta bur bsgrags: grong khyer rnams la srung sngags spel:

btsan po'i mkhar rdzong tshud pas na: drang srong rnams kyi ngan sngags kyis: bshig par nus pa ma yin no: byad ma 'bum gyis glags mi rnyed: 'di ni srung ba kun gyi mchog: sa ma ya: gnyis pa zlog pa'i rim pa ni: 'khor lo dbus su bhyo zlog la: grong khyer bkod pa srung ba ltar: mu khyud dmod pa gang shes bri: mtshon cha phyir bstan me phung bri: yig 'bru lha yi ngo bor bsgom: 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa yis: zlog pa'i las rnams mdzad par bsam: sngags rnams bzla zhing rab gnas bya: 'bru nag dug khrag sbyar ba yi: gtor ma zur gsum zhal ldan pa'i: nang du bcug gam rtse ru brgyang: drag rgyan rngam brjid ldan par bya: tha mar zor rdzas rnams kyis bskor: sngags pa drag po'i chas su zhugs: lho yi phyogs su kha bltas te: 'jam dpal khros pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom: gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang: gtor snod gshin rje rol pa'i zhing: gtor rgyu sha dang rus pa'i ri: khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil: gtor ma gshin rje'i dmag gi dpung: dbus su 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed: phyogs bzhir gshed chen yab yum rnams: 'chi bdag phyogs skyong bcu gnyis dang: dregs pa chen po sgo ba bzhi: gri thogs ging chen sde bzhi dang: dar nag g.yab rdeb bdud po bzhi: shwa thogs rtsis bzhi shan pa bzhi: gzhan yang ma gshin sprul pa'i tshogs: kun kyang mthing nag 'bar ba la: ma he khros pa'i gdong pa can: ngur mo'i 'brug sgra 'jigs su rung: 'khor lo bskor zhing lcags kyu 'debs: ral gris gtubs shing dgra st+was gshag: tho bas brdung zhing khram la 'debs: dug rlangs nag po 'thor ba yis: kun kyang zlog pa'i las rnams mdzad: ma bhyo: gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen 'jam dpal dbyings nas bzhengs: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'dir gshegs la: drag po e yi gdan la bzhugs: sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod:

sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: za ba'i 'dre dang phung ba'i sri: byad ma rbod gtong zlog tu gsol: zhes bskul zlog sngags drag tu bzla: phyag mtshan 'khor lo 'bar ba las: bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar 'phros nas: byad ma rbod gtong dgra bgegs kyi: lus gtubs ye shes me yis bsregs: phyag mtshan nam mkha'i mthar khyab pas: bar chad ming yang med par bsam: bar chad chag chen byad rbod sogs: las 'di brtsams pas zlog pa dang: bstan pa bshig pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni: gang gis rtsom pa sa mkhar la: sgyogs kyis phog pa lta bur 'jig: sa ma ya: gsum pa gsad pa'i las sbyor ni: 'khor lo'i dbus su dgra bgegs kyi: ming rus gzugs byang zag rdzas byugs: grong khyer gsad pa'i dmod pa sbyar: che ge mo mā ra ya rbad: sha khrag zan la nya bo'i gzugs: de yi snying gar 'khor lo bcug: dkar byang dmar byang gnyis ka la: lha dbye 'gugs pa yang yang bya: che ge mo'i lha srung pra be sha ya phaṭa: che ge mo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: aṅku sha dza: hūm̐: dug rlangs khol 'dra gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams: bstan la sdang zhing 'gro la 'tshe byed pa'i: log par 'dren pa bsgral bar dam bcas pa'i: thugs dam dus la ma g.yel sa ma ya: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: gshin rje'i rgyal po thams cad dang: las kyi gshin rje thams cad gson: las ngan sdig can dgra bo 'dis: phar la ma rgol tshur la gnod: bstan la sdang sems ngan pa skyes: nga yi yid la brnag pa 'di: mngon shes ldan kun ltos dang shes: 'jam dpal bden pa'i bka' ma gcag: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rnal 'byor la: gnod pa'i bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs: khyod kyis bsgral bar dam bcas pa'i: sngar smras rjes su bshol med pas: gsod pa'i 'phrul 'khor khyod kyis chos: shan pa'i dmag dpung myur bar 'dus: mtshon cha'i so brdar dus la bab: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: gshin rje'i rgyal po bka' la nyon:

gshin rje'i rgyal po thams cad kyis: 'khor la bka' nan ma chung zhig: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: las mkhan thams cad bka' la nyon: nag po 'joms byed la sogs pa: las kyi gshin rje thams cad kyis: dgra la jag par chas re ran: ya ma rā dza'i bka' nyan pa: kong rtse brag 'joms la sogs pa'i: las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang: dung gi bya rgod mgo can sogs: lcags kyu thogs pa'i pho nya rnams: las ngan dgra bgegs 'dir khug cig: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khyod kyi bka' nyan mi bsrun pa: gshin rje a ba glang mgo sogs: lho phyogs gser gyi stag mgo can: zhags pa dbyug to thogs pa rnams: ske nas khrid cing dbyug pas rdungs: dmigs pa'i 'ben la ā be sha: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: bka' yi blon chen ma ru tse: khyod kyi mngag gzhug chen po ni: mig dmar tel pa rmigs pa sogs: bse yi dur bya kaṅka'i mgo: lcags sgrog thogs pa khyed rnams kyis: dmigs pa'i 'ben la dbyer med sdoms: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sras mchog ral pa tshar dgu chos: dmag dpon chos rgyal daṇḍi sogs: lcags kyi spyang ki'i gdong pa can: dril bu 'khor lo thogs pa rnams: dgra bgegs myos shing glo snying gdungs: zhes bskul zhe sdang cher 'khrugs nas: las gshin dmag tshogs phyogs bcur byer: dgra bgegs bkug nas rten la bstim: dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum gyur: las kyi gshin rje thams cad kyis: lcags kyus snying gi nṛ tri phug: 'khor los klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs: de nas glo snying gtubs par bsam: nyi ma bzhi pa'i drag sngags mthar: 'khor lor bkod pa'i gsang sngags bzla: rtags rdzogs liṅga mtshon chas gtubs: bar pa gtor ma'i nang du bstab: sman cha khrag dang zhun chen sbyar: dug shing hom gyi me sbar la: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me chen 'bar:

zhal ni gnam sa tsam du gdangs: za skal brnag pa 'di zo la: ming gi lhag ma med par gyis: che ge mo dzwa la raṃ: thal ba liṅga'i stod cha bcas: klu bdud btsan la gtad par bya: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la chas: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: las kyi gshin rje khyed rnams ni: phar btang tshur la ma ldog cig: dgra bgegs rnams la thog zor rgyob: rten gyi yul mkhar med par gyis: bhyo bhyo dgra bgegs steng du bhyo: zlog zlog chag chen nyam nga zlog: dgra bgegs byad ma chag chen ngan pa sha ri bhyo zlog: drag tu bzlas shing rakta 'thor: dar nag phyar zhing drag rol bcas: gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phang: nad mtshon thog gi char phab ste: gnod byed rmeg med brlags par bsam: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: las kyi gshin rje chu srin gdong: ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung: za skal dgra 'di khyod la gtad: las skal bgegs 'di khyod kyis zo: mnar med dmyal bar khyod gnas pas: nam yang steng du ma gtang zhig: che ge mo st+waṃ bha ya nan: stobs chen dpung mang su yin kyang: zla gcig las ni mi 'gor 'chi: bdun rgyud rigs kyang brlag par 'gyur: sa ma ya: de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang: lhar snang thams cad rim par 'dus: mkha' la sprin chen thim pa ltar: spros pa med pa'i ngang la gnas: slar yang bdag nyid dpal gyi sku: rdo rje'i mkhar du tshud par bsam: de ltar sku yi sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro phan gang bgyis byang chub chen por bsngo: myur du 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sa thob nas: mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i dpal du 'byung bar shog: brgyud gsum bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin ltar gtibs: yi dam lha yis dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: rlung ltar myur ba'i dam can phrin las mdzad: byin chen dngos grub mthu myur bkra shis bsam: de ltar rim par nges rdzogs sgom pa'am: yang na gsal snang rdzogs pas thun gcig gis:

nyams su blang na byang chub 'bras bu thob: bar chad bgegs bral chag chen ngan pa bzlog: log lta tshar gcod phyi pa'i dmag dpung 'joms: ngan g.yo'i 'phrul 'khor thams cad ngang gis 'jig: bkra shis mthu myur drag sngags rgyal po 'di: da lta nyams longs ma 'ongs don du sbos: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad nas kyang: 'gro ba'i rkyen zlog bstan pa'i lcags ri yin: drag sngags kun gyi bcud bsdus 'di lta bu: drag shul mthu ldan bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'i: bod yul bstan pa'i lcags ri 'byung ba yi: sngags pas nyams longs byang chub sems bskyed nas: bstan dang 'gro ba'i 'gal rkyen bzlog par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya:1$0000250 ༁ྃ: bod khams bde thabs chos bcu yi: bstan pa srung ba'i skor bzhi las: rta mgrin bskal pa'i me dpung bzhugs:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈ gsang sngags ston pa rdo rje 'dzin: padma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: gu ru rje la yang gsol ba: khyad par bla med gsang ba sngags: de la bar chad 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dul thabs bdag la bstsal du gsol: zhus pas gu rus 'di skad gsungs: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi: bstan pa tshul bzhin skyong ba la: bar chad 'byung po byung gyur na: rta mgrin dbang chen rol pa yi: gsung gi dngos grub thob pa yi: las sbyor bskal pa'i me lta bus: gzhom par byed pa'i man ngag bsgrub: bla ma'i spyi dpal dkyil 'khor gtso: mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang phyug che: dpal chen rta mgrin lha tshogs la: byang chub bar du skyabs su gzung: ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcad phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: dpal chen rta mgrin skur bsgoms nas: sprul pas bgegs rnams thal bar bya: snang srid ma lus gser gyi ri: 'bar ba'i rtse brgyad khro bo brgyad: phra men dgu khri dgu 'bum 'phro: bskal pa'i me dpung mched cing 'bar: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang:

gnas dang lus ngag yid la bstim: snod rnams dbang chen rol pa'i zhing: bcud rnams dbang chen yab dang yum: yo byad phyi nang gsang ba yi: mchod sprin dpag med mkha' la dkrigs: de dbus dbang chen rol pa yi: pho brang chen po 'od du 'bar: dbus su padma nyi zla la: hrīḥlas gar dbang spyan ras gzigs: dmar po pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: gnyis med gsang ba'i yum dang 'khril: byang chub sems kyis rgyal ba mchod: 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs bde la bkod: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: gar dbang snying rje'i cho 'phrul las: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang: bdag nyid dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: dmar nag g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal: rta mgo gsum ldan phyag drug pa: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ral gri g.yas: dril bu dung dmar sbrul zhags g.yon: gshog brgyangs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhabs bzhi klu rgyal pho mo mnan: yum chen padma gzi ldan ma: kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud: byi la pu shud phra men 'gyed: sku las ye shes me chen 'bar: phyogs bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la: sras mchog dbang chen sde bzhi ni: dkar ser dmar ljang zhal gsum ldan: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dbang gi gsang ba'i yum bzhi 'khril: khyams la zil gnon khro bo brgyad: yum bcas sgo bzhi dbang mo dang: mu ran srung ba'i bka' srung tshogs: gcig las du mar snang ba'i sku: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos: ye shes lnga la dbang bsgyur bas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: dbyings las skur bzhengs mtha' yas pa'i: ye shes khro rgyal sku gsung thugs: sprul pa sras bcas spyan drangs nas: 'gugs bstim dbyer med dgyes pa skyed: sprul pa'i khro mo'i tshogs rnams kyis: phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod phul: e ma hoḥche ba'i sku: nyid kyi gar ni rnam par 'gyur: rgyal ba'i gsung dbyangs kun la khyab: g.yo ba med pa'i thugs mchog mnga' ho:

thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' yi: srog gor nyi ma la gnas pa'i: rdo rje hrīḥyis mtshan pa la: sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: snod bcud dkyil 'khor rnams la phog: 'brug stong ldir ba'i ngur sgra yis: 'khor 'das 'jig rten zhing kun g.yos: rgyal kun dngos grub char ltar phab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'thibs: dregs pa las la rlung ltar 'tshubs: dpal gyi gzi brjid chen pos mnan: dngos grub phrin las 'grub par bsam: hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: yang gsang khros pa'i sngags bzlas pas: grags pa thams cad sngags su thos: phyogs bcur rgyal ba'i chos nyan nas: 'phags pa'i sa la mngon byed pa: dbang chen gsung gi grub mtha' 'o: sa ma ya: drag sngags sgo nas bsrung ba ni: rtsibs bzhi rtsibs brgyad la sogs pa'i: lha gnas 'khor lor sngags bkod pa: rgyas par bri 'am yang na ni: lha gnas sa bon bkod pa'i mthar: drag sngags sham bur srung sngags spel: chos sman byugs la lhar bsgom mam: lha yi ngo bo yig 'bru las: 'od 'phros bsgrub bya srung bar bsam: thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'phros pa'i: grangs med lu gu rgyud du sbrel: sngags sgra 'brug stong sgrog pa yis: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang bar khyab: yi ge 'khor lo'i nang du tshud: bar chad gang gis mi tshugs bsam: drag sngags tha mar sngags 'di spel:

che ge mo rakṣa rakṣa hrīḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐: bar chad bdud kyi phyogs las rgyal: dur khrod sa la e gru gsum: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris pa'i khar: 'bru nag gtor ma zur gsum bsham: srung ba'i 'khor lor zlog ces bsgyur: rtse la brgyangs shing drag rgyan bya: zor gyi thun dang mchod rdzas bsham: skad cig dur khrod rol pa'i zhing: khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha yi ri: rus pa'i gram bu gcal du bkram: drag po'i pho brang chen po'i dbus: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po ni: sde bzhi zil gnon khro bo brgyad: kun kyang rta gdong 'bar ba'i zhal: yum dang sgo srung bka' sdod bcas: sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gsung ni rta skad 'brug ltar sgrog: dmigs med thugs rjes las la rngams: bskal pa'i me phung 'khrugs ltar bsam: hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du skul: mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa 'bul: tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: spro na ma mo'i ging skad kyis: skul cing rakta yang yang phyar: khrag chen phyogs bcu kun tu gtor: dpang gzu bden pa yang yang bdar: phung shul sa la brub khung bya: dgra'am bgegs chen gnas pa'i rdzas: de yis liṅga bzos pa'i nang: dug khrag gis bris ming byang bcug: bya 'ug dang ru 'dre 'jigs sogs: rdzas ngan sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug: pra be sha yi sngags sham gyis: phra men mang pos rdzas ngan char: phab pas rgyab rten bros par bsam: de nas 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya bcas: aṅku sha ya'i sngags sham sbyar: phra men lcags kyu thogs pa yis: snying nas bzung zhing bkug pa dang: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes sbyar bas: phra men rnams kyis zhags pas bcings: lcags sgrog gis bsdams dril bus myos:

gzugs byang rnams dang dbyer med bsres: zangs lcags phye ma rbab rdo dang: yungs dkar dug dang ske tshe'i thun: khrag sogs sbyar bas brabs nas su: phra men rnams kyis mtshon cha'i char: phab pas lus rnams rdul du brlag: mā ra ya phaṭa rbad sbyar ba: rig pa hur phyung thog ltar bzla: phur pa'i sku stod khro bo la: sku smad zur gsum dbal dang ldan: gnas gsum yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang ldan: rtse mor hrīḥlas phaṭa 'phros pas: dgra bgegs nṛ tri'i srog la bab: drag po'i yi ge mer 'bar bas: rtsa yi phung por thog brgyab bzhin: bsregs shing rdul du brlags par bsam: rjes su bsad rtags byung ba na: rnam shes a yi rang bzhin du: rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs kar bstim: gzugs byang mtshon chas gtubs byas la: cha gcig me yi hom du bsreg: cha gcig gtor ma la bstabs nas: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag gis: lha tshogs thams cad dgyes par bsam: gtor ma phyir dpag rakta phyar: dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du bhyo: zhes pa'i dmod pa sbyar nas su: lha tshogs dmag ltar chas nas kyang: sdig can 'byung po'i dpung rnams la: g.yul bkyes rdul du brlags par bsam: lha tshogs thams cad mkha' la bteg: gtor ma me phung mtshon cha'i char: 'byung po'i phyogs dang gnas pa'i rten: rgyu ba'i lam la gtor ma brdeg: thal mo dang ni dul mo brdab: rtswa phung me yis bsregs pa ltar: rjes shul tsam yang med par bsam: spro na zlog pa'i dmod pa sbyar: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen padma he ru ka: rta skad rngams bzhad snang srid 'dar: khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud: srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon: drag shul bka' sdod 'khor bcas kyis: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi: bstan la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad: khro rgyal rnams kyi stobs kyis zlog:

ming tsam rdul tsam med par gyis: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: sgyur ro bgegs chen bdud la bhyo: gtor ma 'phang rjes srung 'khor bsgom: thal ba mnan pa'i las bya 'o: sa ma ya: dgra 'am 'byung po'i gzugs byang la: rtags rdzogs bar du dgug gzhug bya: gsad pa'i las sbyor tshad rdzogs nas: phung shul sa la hom gru gsum: dug shing tsher ma can brtsigs la: zhun chen mar dang dug khrag sbyar: shan pa'i rigs kyis me sbar la: drag po'i las kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom: skul zhing dzwa la raṃ zhes pas: yid ches bar du lan grangs 'bul: lha rnams rang bzhin dbyings su bstim: sa ma ya: 'byung po bsgral pa'i gzugs phung dang: thal ba mnan pa'i steng du 'am: yang na 'byung po gnas pa'i sar: thams cad drag po'i chas su zhugs: snang srid dbang drag rol pa yi: dkyil 'khor chen por bltas nas su: dbang chen rol pa'i nga rgyal gyis: thams cad lu gu rgyud du sbrel: drag po'i sngags byang 'ur gyis bsgrag: hūm̐: rta yi brtul zhugs chen po sogs: dbang chen rol pa'i rtog pa bzhengs: dbyangs su gyer zhing nga rgyal gzung: g.yas su bskor zhing g.yon du brdung: lag gnyis sor mo bsnol nas su: mthe bong rna ba ltar byas nas: spyi bor bzhag pa rta yi rgya: sa steng kun tu mchongs pa'i gar: 'byung po gzir gnan cho ga yis: stobs can kun gyi rgyu lam chad: gzhan yang grong rdal grong gi dbus: lung gsum 'dus dang lam gyi srang: dogs pa yod pa'i phyogs su brdung: 'byung po kun gyi rgyu lam chad: bkra shis byin chags gnas su 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'byung po bskrad pa'i sbyor ba ni: liṅga rlung gis bteg pa yi: rkang pa yaṃ gyis mtshan pa bri: utstsha ta ya phaṭa sbyar ba'i: sngags bkod 'gugs bstim bsgral ba dang: las kyi sbyor ba rdzogs par bya: rtags mthong nges pa rnyed pa na: liṅga rnga mong thod par bcug: rang yul mi ldog 'babs chur 'phang:

'gro ba rnams la phan gdags slad: rdo rje phur bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: bdud dgra thams cad btul ba na: byang chub bar chad med par thob: gzhan don rgya chen lhun gyis grub: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku: bla ma mchog la skyabs gsol nas: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis: bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs bsgral nas: dpal chen go 'phang 'thob par bgyi: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: mthing nag yum bcas phur bu 'dril: snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa: khro rgyal yaksha skar ltar 'khrugs: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kī la yas: phyogs bcu'i 'byung po thams cad nan: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma bcos gsal rdzogs rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni: mgo bo rgya mdud khro bo'i zhal dang ldan: nyi ma'i spyan gyis bgegs dpung thal bar sreg: zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra ni 'brug ltar sgrog: shangs nas 'thor rlung gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: rgya mdud gong mar rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sprin ltar gtibs: 'chang gzung padma kha sprod 'bar ba'i dbus: rdo rje'i gur khang dur khrod gzhal yas khang: phyi nang kun tu khro bo'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: rgya mdud 'og mar dam can srung ma'i tshogs: dbal zur gsum pa spu gri ltar rno ba: bdud bzhi dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying la zug: chu srin kha nas sbrul nag bsnol mar 'khyugs: thog ser bu yug dug gi char pa 'beb: stod smad kun tu me chu rlung 'khrugs pas: kī la ya yi drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: phur pa'i tshwa tshwas dgra bgegs klad pa 'gems: bdag nyid hūm̐ gyur pho brang dbus su zhugs: rtsa ba'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu ni: mthing nag lcags kyi ral pa gyen du 'khyil: phyag gnyis phur 'dril zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bgrad:

'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis med yum dang 'khril: rdo rje'i gshog brgyangs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ye shes me 'bar spyi bo dung khang du: buddha sras mchog smug nag phur bu 'dril: mgrin par padma thugs kar badzra dang: lte bar ratna gsang bar karma rnams: dmar mthing ser ljang phur bu 'dril ba yi: ye shes lnga ldan thugs kyi dpal be 'ur: ye shes sems dpas rab brgyan srog gi gor: rdo rje hūm̐ nang ming yig thig le bcas: sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer me phung 'bar: bdud dpung gang gis gzhom pa med par bsam: rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas gsal snang rdzogs pa na: sras mchog phur bu e yi steng du bkod: hūm̐: drag por bskyed pa'i phur pa ni: mthing nag lcags kyi ral pa can: utpal rgyas pa'i mdog 'dra ba: sku smad e yi rang bzhin can: phyag gnyis sgrol byed phur pa 'dril: dkar dmar mthing ga'i phra btab pa: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzi chen 'bar: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dīpta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: brag kha'i chu 'bab bzhin du bzla: lcags sam bhandha'i snod nang du: 'bru nag khrag gis sbrus pa yi: zur gsum sha khrag mtshon chas brgyan: e yi steng du bkod nas su: hūm̐: khro rgyal yaksha skar ltar 'khrugs: bdud dang dgra bgegs kun bsdus nas: mtshon cha 'bar bas bsgral nas su: gzugs phung dur khrod sa gzhi la: sha yi ri bo khrag gi mtsho: keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri sul du: lcags kyi shwa na chen po rgyu: sku ni ri rab zom dang mnyam: shwa na'i gdong can seng skad sgrog: sku smad phur pa'i dbal dang ldan: phyag gnyis sgrol byed phur bu 'dril: rang 'dra'i yab yum sprul 'khor bcas: phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal stobs 'dus pa: bdud dpung brlag pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ka taṃ ka ye: dza ye bi dza ye: a dzi te a pa rā dzi te mā ra se na pra mardha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa:

drag sngags thog 'brug 'ur ltar bzla: sgrub pa'i phur bu bzhad pa dang: las kyi phur bu 'phur ba dang: gtor mar me 'bar du ba phyur: rtags de byung na gang brtsams 'grub: sa ma ya: de nas gdab pa'i las la 'jug: dgra bgegs zag rdzas ming rus bcas: phung shul sa yi brub khung du: bcug nas thun thag zor la btags: dang por dgra bgegs rgyab rten la: dbye ba'i phur pa gdab pa ni: mthing nag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'aphros: phur srung dam can las la bskul: bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: gsad pa'i khang pa gru gsum nang: dgra bgegs 'gugs shing gzhug par bya: dam can lcam dral bcu gnyis bcas: dmag tshogs 'khor lo'i gnas su lhags: sprul pa'i shwa na grangs med pa: phur srung jag pa las la chas: lcags kyu la sogs 'gugs byed thogs: dgra bgegs rang dbang med par bkug: phra men rdzas ngan char thogs pa: spros pas 'go ba'i lha lnga bskrad: rdzas ngan phur bu mgo la btab: gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa yi: phur bu yungs dkar thun gyi rdzas: brabs pas dbyer med gzugs la bstim: mthu 'phrog phur bu dug gi thun: gdab pas bkrag mdangs rang la bsdu: gsum pa byad du gzhug pa'i phyir: phra men 'ching byed thogs pa yis: byad phur yan lag rnams la gdab: dru gu thul du bcings par bsam: bzhi pa smyo phur dug khrag ni: phra men kun gyis thogs nas su: dgra bgegs bu ga dgu la gdab: dran med brgyal zhing myos par bsam: gsad pa'i phur pa sras mchog de: dkar nag mtshams su gdab pa yis: khrag rtsa tshe yi dwangs ma bcom: nṛ tri rtswa mes bcom bzhin bsregs: khong khrag lhud kyis lud par bsam: khug rtags dgra yi bla 'khyams 'ong: sgra dang dri ni byung ba'i tshe: gdab pa'i las byas bsad rtags rdzogs: de nas gcod pa'i phur pa ni: shwa na bshan gri thod phur can: du mas gzugs phung khrol gyis bshig: pho g.yas mo g.yon brtsams te gdab: zangs lcags dug rdo mtshe khrag thun:

nad rlangs dug dang mtshon cha'i char: brabs pa'i phur bu khyab par gdab: 'byung po ser po tho lum thogs: dgra bgegs phye ma bzhin du 'thags: yab yum rol pa'i gtun khung du: gtun gyis dmigs med ngang du btang: phur bu tho bas brdung bar bya: bsnyen phur klad la bskor nas su: thugs ka'i a las 'od 'phros pas: stong khams khyab cing tshur 'dus pas: dgra bgegs tshe srog a ru 'dus: phur pa'i rtse ru ye re ba: bdag gi thugs ka'i a la bstim: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan par bsam: tshe phur snying gi dkyil du gdab: sras mchog phur bu klad la bskor: snying ga'i a las grangs med spros: tshur 'dus phur pa'i dbal la a: 'od zer dkar po 'phros pa yis: dgra bgegs sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsam: khrus lung ming byang nṛ trir gdab: sras mchog slar yang lhar gsal ba'i: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'bar: bdud rtsi phud kyi skyems drangs la: yi ge brgya pas nyes byas bshags: bdag kyang rtsa ba'i lhar gsal ba'i: thugs ka'i a las 'od 'phros pas: las kyi sgrib pa sbyong bar bsam: sras mchog phur bu klad la bskor: thugs ka'i 'od kyis stong khams khyab: dmigs bya'i rnam shes a ru bsdus: 'og min gnas su spar bar bya: dgra bgegs ming byang gang yin bsregs: srog phur bdag phur dgra la gdab: 'debs pa po dang gdab pa'i yul: 'debs byed dbyer med ro gcig pa: khregs chod lta ba'i don la bzhag: rig pa'i phur pa dbyings la gdab: byang chub sems phur sngon 'gro ba'i: yab yum gnyis med rol pa yi: bde chen phur pa yum mkhar gdab: dgra ni gso ba'i las la bsngags: de yang rnam shes zhal du bcug: sku yi dbyibs brgyud yum mkhar phab: sras mchog rdo rje sems chen po: brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i sras su bya: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum la: phur pa bcu gnyis gdab pa'i las: bsdu na phur bzhir 'dus pa 'o: sa ma ya: rdzong bcas gdab pa'i las rdzogs nas:

rgyas par lha grangs phur pa thogs: lha rnams sil bur bskul nas su: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi sprul pa rnams: mkha' khyab phur bu'i sprin spros pas: dgra bgegs chag chen ngan pa bzlog: tshur la mi zlog mthar bskrad nas: rdul phran bzhin du brlags par bsam: sras mchog phur bu klad la bskor: phur thun drag po ser ltar 'beb: bar chad chag chen rnams la gdab: gnod pa byung ba'i phyogs su bsgral: hūm̐: bskal pa me rlung 'tshubs pa'i stong khams nas: mthing nag 'bar ba e khrom sgo phyes la: thog ltar rgyug pa'i phur bu bang ma bul: glog ltar 'khyugs pa'i g.yab mo rtsal ma zhan: 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i drag sngags mthu ma chung: ser ltar 'khrigs pa'i phur bu las la chos: rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i sprul pa dgra la chos: sprin ltar 'thibs pa'i rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rnams: rdo rje phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs ma g.yel: bdag nyid lha mchog dpal chen gzhon nu'i sku: ind+ra nī la'i lhun po srid rtser sleb: nam mkha'i zhal mdog zang yag mche ba can: spyan mig khyung gi lta stangs gyen thur gzigs: gnam lcags zhun ma'i tshul can phyag gnyis kyis: ri rab phur bu bdud chen klad pa 'gems: dpa' bo'i gom stabs bskal pa'i me 'drar 'tshubs: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog stong gsum g.yo: phyogs bcu khro rgyal rngams pa'i dbus na 'gying: dpal chen dpal 'bar khyod kyis rgyab rten mdzod: gsang sngags bstan la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: dpal gyi bka' nyan khyod kyis dgra snying longs: snying khrag 'thung zhing don snying dpa' zas gyis: byang chub sgrub la bdud dang bgegs byung na: dpal chen khyod kyis ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: phra men sprul tshogs thams cad las la chos: rno dbal phur bus bdud bgegs snying phug la: lus ngag yid gsum thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: ltas ngan cho 'phrul chag chen nyam nga dang: dus min 'chi ba byad ma rbod gtong bcas:

mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad lha srung khros pa dang: khro rgyal phra men gshin rje'i pho nya 'gyed: phyi pa'i 'phrul 'khor lha min ngan sngags rnams: dam sri'i g.yo 'phrul dug mtshon sbyor ngan kun: thams cad ma lus gcig tu bsdus nas kyang: bhyo bhyo dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du bhyo: sgyur ro phur pa'i dbal gyis bdud la sgyur: bdud dpung thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlogs: drag sngags bzla zhing rig pa hur phyung bas: gang la brtsams pa thams cad 'joms par 'gyur: sa ma ya: de nas thun gyi phur bu 'phen: phyogs bcu kun tu rakta gtor: sngags pa bdud kyi chas su zhugs: las byed phur bu'i dmag tshogs rnams: gang du btang ba der chas nas: g.yul chen mtshon cha phur bu'i zor: dgra dang bgegs la brgyabs pa yis: sgron me rlung gis bcom pa ltar: tshar bcad drag po'i las mdzad bsam: hūm̐: srid gsum 'di na che ba'i 'byung po kun: rakta 'ong ngo phur bu'i zor lam phyes: thun zor 'phen pas sku zur zor sgo phyes: ma nyes ma lan dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams: ma yo ma bcos gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu ste: las kyi shwa na dgra la chos: khyod kyi bka' nyan srung ma rnams: g.yul ngo chen po da shoms shig: zor 'di bar chad bdud la 'phen: zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phen: bar chad chag chen bzlog phyir 'phen: rig 'dzin bla mas rgyab rten mdzod: yi dam lha tshogs mthu ma chung: chos skyong srung ma rtsal ma zhan: las kyi pho nya chen po rnams: mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings nas rgyugs: sku ni ri rab zom dang mnyam: phyag na ri rab phur zor thogs: bskal pa'i me 'bar thog ltar 'phen: bdud dpung chag chen g.yul ngo zlog: dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying la rgyob: ming gi lhag ma med par gyis: drag sngags bzla zhing zor rnams 'phang: 'jigs rung khyung gis rjes snyog gcad:

srung sngags bzla zhing srung 'khor bsgom: rnam 'joms gzungs kyis 'dzul chog bya: tshe 'gugs phur bu'i dbang yang blang: gang 'dod nyams pa tshar gcod 'gyur: sa ma ya: bsgrubs pa'i phur pa gnas gsum du: gtugs shing bsgril la lus la 'chang: hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba'i: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang skur cig: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku gsung thugs su bdag gyur cig: khyad par brgyad kyi dngos grub thob: rdo rje'i mkhar du zhugs pa 'dra: bar chad las rgyal don rnams 'grub: lha sras khyod kyi brgyud 'dzin pa'i: skal ldan rnams kyi snying nor gyis: sa ma ya:1$0000250 ༁ྃ: bod khams bde thabs chos bcu yi: bstan pa srung ba'i skor bzhi las: mgon po gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈ bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: bdud 'dul drag po rtsal la 'dud: bdag 'dra lha sras mu khri yis: padma thod phreng la gsol ba: gsang sngags rnal 'byor thams cad kyi: sku la bsdo ba'i dgra 'dul zhing: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po yi: so kha srung ba'i srung ma che: drag rtsal mthu ldan myur mgyogs can: bkra shis myur mgyogs che ba yi: mgon po'i sgrub pa bstsal du gsol:

zhes zhus gu rus bka' bstsal pa: de ltar bstan pa srung ba'i thabs: snying por bsdus te 'di ru bstan: bla ma mgon po dbyer med par: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir: bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed do: gru gsum e yi klong dkyil du: 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i gur khang dbus: pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: byin rlabs mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus: sems can kun gyi don byas nas: yongs gyur bdag nyid dpal chen po: bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: beng chen mchan bcug zhabs gnyis bgrad: e ka dzā ṭi gnyis med 'khril: mthing nag g.yu spyang snying khrag 'dzin: rdo rje'i gshog brgyangs dur khrod chas: ye shes me phung klong du bzhugs: thugs kar 'od kyi gur khyim dbus: ye shes sems dpa' he ru ka: mthing nag rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ sngags phreng: de las sprul pa'i khro chung gis: 'byung po bkug ste gdan du byas: khro bo'i sprin spros bdud dpung bcom: tshur 'dus ma hā kā la bcu: beng phur 'dzin pas 'byung po gzir: phra men bya rog gdong can gyis: phyogs mtshams ma lus srung bar bsam: oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: de ni bsnyen pa'i rim pa 'o: sa ma ya: de nas las sgrub rim pa ni: sku 'bag 'bur du dod pa 'am: dar nag ngos su gser gyis bri: gsung rten 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i: dbus su hūm̐ bhyo srog sngags dang: rtsibs la sde brgyad snying po bkod: mu khyud gcig dril shā sa na: ye shes brtan pa'i sngags rnams 'god: bdag srung dngos grub stsol ba dang: dgra bgegs sgrol ces spel tshig sbyar: pha wang long bur hūm̐ bris pa: dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying: ma nyams pa 'am dum bu bcas: thod byang 'bru sman rin po ches:

bkang ba'i nang du lhan cig bzhag: gri lcags las byas rtse gsum mdung: dar nag sngags kyis mtshan pa bcas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rten: phyi rten ru mtshon sku 'bag dang: bdud chas 'chams stabs rta nag g.yag: ra lug bya nag rta dmar sogs: khyad par lcags sam thod pa'i snod: thod chang 'bru sna'i gtor mas bkang: rno dbal dbyibs dang drag rgyan can: sku gzugs thugs rten ru mtshon gzug: nang du gtor sngags shog dril bcug: las gtor sha dang khrag gis brgyan: dus dang rgyun du 'bul bar bya: dur khrod gnas su stegs bu la: ro sol gyis byugs khrag chen dang: mtshal gyis dkyil 'khor bri ba ni: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad e dang bcas: dbus su rten rnams bkod par bya: las mgon mdun du dmigs nas su: yab yum thugs kar nyi ma la: hūm̐ bhyo'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor: bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul: ci bcol las rnams sgrub par bsam: sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med pa: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: thogs pa rnams kyis dgra bo bkug: smyo khrag char phab lha srung bros: gtor zor thun gyis gzugs phung bshig: rtse gsum 'bar bas dgra srog bcad: sha khrag kun gyis rol par bsam: seng skad nga ro bsgrags pa yis: sde brgyad bdud dmag 'ur gyis 'dus: dgra bgegs sha khrag rol nas kyang: thams cad zhe sdang cher 'khrugs nas: gad rgyangs sgrog cing ru mtshon phyar: dar nag g.yab mo brdabs nas su: dgra bo'i yul du chas par bsam: phyag g.yas mdung dar brdabs pa yis: dgra la g.yul ngo cher bkyes te: bdud dmag rnams kyis mtshon char phab: mi bsad yul mkhar bshig pa dang: lha srung bran du bkol bar bsam: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor don rnams 'grub: sa ma ya: gtor mchod raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang: drag po bandha'i snod yangs su: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral pa yi: sha yi ri bo khrag gi mtsho: ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bo la:

phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mdun du dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba la: hūm̐ las bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong: mthing nag char sprin 'khrugs pa'i mdog: phyag g.yas kha ṭwāṃ dar nag phyar: g.yon pas sha khrag gtor ma bsnams: dar nag gos gsol bdud kyi chas: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog 'chibs: bhyo las bdud mo seng ge'i gdong: dmar mo rtse gsum glo snying 'dzin: ber dmar gsol nas btsan rta 'chibs: g.yas g.yon bam ro pho mo gnyis: 'jigs gzugs spyi 'u tshugs su 'gro: sde brgyad bdud dmag 'bum gyis bskor: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od 'phros 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hriṃ dza: ḍā ki si na ra ma tri hriṃ dza: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dza: drag tu bzlas shing thod rnga dang: rkang gling dung chen shugs pa'i sgra: drag po'i rol mo myur bas 'bod: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni de bī ko ṭi'i zhing: gnas kyi ming ni dpal gyi tsa ri tra: dur khrod ming ni rngams pa sgra chen sgrog: gzhan yang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams nas: yab gcig dpal ldan mgon po seng ge'i gdong: yum gcig lha mo si na ra ma bcas: pho nya las mkhan bdud dmag stong sde'i tshogs: dam tshig dbang gis myur du spyan 'dren na: ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā dza: hūm̐: drag por gshegs pas khrag gi mchod yon 'bul: dug chu'i zhabs bsil dgra bgegs gdan la bzhugs: mgo phreng dbang po'i me tog sku la brgyan: 'dre 'jigs tshil chen bsregs pa'i dud sprin gtibs: zhun chen ro ras bskal pa'i me chen sbar: khrag zhag mkhris pa'i dri chab rgya mtshor bskyil: sha dang rus pa'i lhun po cher spungs te: bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong sbyar dpa' bo'i phud:

'bru sna shing tog bza' dang btung ba'i tshogs: phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: sngon gyi khas blangs dam las ma g.yel bar: bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: he ru ka dpal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: zhing skyong chen po seng ge'i gdong pa can: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang bstod pa rgya cher bya: mgon po mchod cing bstod pas 'grub: sa ma ya: grub nas bstan dgra bsgral ba'i phyir: phung shul sa la gru gsum hom: dgra bo'i liṅga zag rdzas bcas: 'bod rbad gsad gsum sngags bzlas la: gsod pa'i las sbyor brtsam par bya: gzhan yang g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir: dur khrod sa la bang rim bzhi: gtor ma lha grangs bshams nas su: ru mtshon sku gzugs sngags byang dang: nam mkha' mda' 'phang rgyang gsum dang: pho gdong mo gdong bu gdong dang: sku glud spyan gzigs rnams dang bcas: rta nag g.yag lug ra gsum dang: bya nag khyi nag rta dmar dang: khyung 'brug stag dang seng ge dang: gcan gzan sder chags rnams kyis bskor: tha mar rtsang dmar bsnol ba dang: stag gzig lpags pas sgab bskor bya: steng du nam mkha'i gdugs phub la: chos nyid dag pa'i sngags kyis sbyang: nam mkha' mdzod kyis mang por spel: sngags pa zhwa nag gos nag gyon: lta ba'i gdeng dang ting 'dzin gsal: lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: nga ni khams gsum kun gyi rgyal: snang srid ma lus dbang du bsdu: hūm̐: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i sa gzhi la: gnam lcags lhun po brtsegs pa'i rtser: 'jigs su rung ba'i gzhal yas khang: thod pa'i rtsig pa ha har bzhad: kaṅka 'dab chags hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrog: logs nas gcan gzan ngar skad 'don: seng chen 'gying zhing stag chen rngams: khyung chen lding zhing bya nag 'jum: 'brug sgra gnam lcags thog ser 'beb: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du:

dgra bgegs mi rta bsgral pa'i khri: phyogs mtshams kun tu me rlung 'khrugs: ro langs rgyug cing king rus gar: khyi spyang ngu zug di ri ri: sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab: spyan gzigs sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: hūm̐: gson cig dgongs shig nag po che: bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po: rdo rje 'chang dbang he ru kas: dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsdus pa yi: rdo rje'i spun grogs dam tshig can: mchod phyir bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la: ma hā kā la gnas 'dir byon: dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal: rngams pa sgra sgrog la sogs pa: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams nas: sgrol ging chen po gshegs su gsol: he ru ka yi gnas bcu nas: zhing skyong chen po gshegs su gsol: ma la ya yi nags khrod nas: bka' sdod chen po gshegs su gsol: gangs rgyal ti se tsa ri tra: la phyi gangs dang kha ba dkar: gangs rgyal padma shel ri sogs: gangs ra rdzong chen la sogs nas: sgrub gnas srung ma gshegs su gsol: rdo rje gdan dang na lend+ra: lha sa bsam yas la sogs nas: chos 'khor skyong ba gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ri rab byang la gnas bcas nas: lha min g.yul ngo zlog par byed: dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang du: bzhugs pa'i gnas su dgyes par mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten: chos 'khor gnyan po'i gtsug lag khang: mdo rgyud bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde: rdo rje 'dzin pa skul zhing mnyes: yi dam lha sgom sngags kyi rgyun: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po sgom: gnyer du gtad pa'i rten chen po: bdud mgon khyod kyi chas su zhugs: gtum la rngams pa'i tshul gyis 'phyongs: ru mtshon nag po phyar nas su: g.yag rgod rta nag rgyan gyis brgyan: dpa' bo khrab chen nga ro sgrog: mtshon cha phyar zhing kus 'debs pa: zhwa nag gos nag ru 'dren tshogs: seng ge stag chen gcan gzan 'phyo:

bya khyung kaṅka bya nag 'bum: mi nag khyi nag 'jigs rung rnams: spyan gzigs phyi yi rten du 'bul: sha khrag 'bru sna'i gtor chen bshams: dur khrod mchog gi mchod sprin dang: sman raka bdud rtsi dpa' bo'i phud: mchod phyir nang gi rten du 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rten: ma hā kā la'i tshogs rnams bskyed: dzap bzlas don gyi rdzogs rim sgom: gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang: dam can 'bod cing dgra la rbad: dam nyams gsod pa'i 'phrul 'khor bca': bdud kyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir: drag po'i las sbyor 'di bgyis pas: ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang: bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrubs: hūm̐ bhyo: skye ba med pa chos kyi dbyings: 'gag med lhun grub 'jig rten du: srid gsum ri rab gling bzhir snang: sna tshogs nam mkha' gdugs su phub: nyi ma zla ba gza' skar bkra: srid pa'i ri rab rtse mo na: bya rgyal khyung chen mkha' la lding: ltas ngan zlog pa'i pho nya yin: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: sku glud rgyan dang ldan pa 'bul: sde brgyad 'byung po thams cad kyis: bzungs pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: thabs kyi mda' la shes rab 'phang: zung 'jug rgyang bu rgyan dang ldan: spyi dang sgos kyi glud du 'bul: spyi chag sgos chag thams cad zlog: pho gdong mo gdong bu gdong rnams: pho mo bu tsha'i glud du 'bul: dus min 'chi ba thams cad zlog: dar zab rkang 'gro 'bru nor rnams: nang bcud mkho dgu'i glud du 'bul: rgud cing dbul phongs nyam thag zlog: gcan gzan 'dab chags sna tshogs pa: ltas ngan cho 'phrul bzlog phyir 'bul: rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: ri rab sku mkhar nam mkha' rnams: yul dang mkhar gyi glud du 'bul: yul dang mkhar la gnod pa zlog: mi rta'i dmag tshogs mang po 'bul: phas kyi g.yul ngo thams cad zlog: hūm̐: bdud kyi mgon po yab dang yum: dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du chos:

'gugs pa'i pho nya lcags kyu can: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'dir khug cig: nad kyi rkyal pa kha phyes la: smyo khrag lha srung rnams la thobs: dgra bo mgon skyabs bral bar gyis: mtshon cha thogs pa'i shan pa 'bum: mdung dang dmar gtor ral gri'i thun: dgra bo'i gzugs phung snying la thobs: srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod: hūm̐: las mgon yab yum bka' 'khor zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams kyi lus ngag yid: kha rje dbang thang tshe bsod longs spyod 'khor: zhal du bstab bo lhag ma med par bzhes: hūm̐ bhyo: bdud kyi dmag dpon seng ge'i gdong: yum mchog si na ra ma dang: blon po badzra sā dhu rtsal: las byed sde brgyad bdud dmag tshogs: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la bhyo: hūm̐ bhyo: pho nya bam ro pho mo gnyis: spre 'u'i gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs: rkang pas dmar gtor dgra la 'phen: cho 'phrul mang po dgra la thongs: hūm̐ bhyo: dmar gyi gtor ma thog gi zor: nyi zla zor 'phen gnam sa g.yo: pho gdong dpa' bo zhubs can rnams: stobs dang ldan cing mtshon cha 'phen: mo gdong bud med 'dre mo'i gzugs: dmod mo byed cing dul mo rdeb: bu gdong byis pa 'ur rdo thogs: ku sgra 'don cing 'ur rdo 'phen: mda' bkra mda' zor sha ra ra: 'phang bkra 'phang zor hri li li: rgyang bu gsal shing rno dbal can: yas stags mthun rdzas sna tshogs dang: bya gcan ri dwags ltas ngan 'phyo: keng rus ro langs gar byed cing: ngar mi 'o dod sna tshogs 'bod: khyi spyang mang po ngu zug byed: cho 'phrul srid gsum g.yo ba yi: yas zor 'di ni dgra la 'phen: bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo: bhyo bhyo dmigs pa'i yul du bhyo: dgra yul thal ba rdul du rlogs: phung byed 'phrul 'khor da phob cig: ces bskul rig pa hur phyung ngo: las rnams 'grub rjes gtang rag gtang: stobs chen g.yul ngo thams cad bzlog: gsad las zhag las mi 'gor ro:

sa ma ya: brgyud 'dzin dam tshig ldan pa la: mgon po'i bka' gtad bya ba ni: dkyil 'khor rten mchod 'du byas la: spyan drangs mchod bstod bzlas pa bya: slob mas mtshon cha 'bru nor sogs: yon du phul nas thal mo sbyar: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa srung: snying nye bkra shis mthu che ba: myur mdzad mgon po seng ge'i gdong: bla mas bdag la bstsal du gsol: de nas slob ma lhar bskyed la: sku rten gtor ma lag tu gtad: hūm̐: las kyi mgon po seng ge'i gdong: yab yum pho nya las byed bcas: sngon gyi rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du: sgrub pa po la grogs gyis shig: kā ya badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ: sngags byang slob ma'i lag tu gtad: bdud rtsi slob mar sbyin pa dang: gtor mar bran la gnyis ka yi: lce la rdo rje bdud rtsi sbyin: spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas su: dam las mi 'da' bro bor bsam: badzra sa ma ya i dan na ra kan: slob mas gsang sngags bzla ru gzhug: hūm̐: dam tshig 'dzin pa'i nag po che: gsung gi gsang sngags bzlas pa yis: phrin las gang brtsam 'grub pa dang: bstan srung dmod pa'i dngos grub stsol: wā ka sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan lag tu bzhag nas su:

hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las pa: rnal 'byor kun gyi bka' sdod che: gsang sngags srung ma mthu rtsal can: thugs rjes rtag tu 'di skyongs shig: sarba tsitta sa ma ya ā sa na tiṣṭhantu: khyad par rten rnams lag tu gtad: hūm̐: bdud kyi mgon po mthu bo che: rtogs na rang dang gnyis su med: ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin ru dra'i rgyu: gnyis med zung 'jug rtogs pa yis: bsnyen sgrub bstan srung las rnams sgrubs: sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā: slob mas dam tshig ma nyams par: bsnyen sgrub mchod pa'i las la brtson: 'di ni bsgrub na snying nye zhing: bkra shis dngos grub myur du stsol: rbad na thogs pa med par 'gro: gsad pa spu gri bzhin du rno: o rgyan padma bdag 'dra dang: lha sras brgyud 'dzin dam ldan la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: bsten sgrub mchod pa'i don la brtson: spyan gzigs spros pa ji ltar che: de dang 'tsham pa'i don rnams sgrub: smon lam btab cing gter du sbas: nam zhig las 'phro can dang 'phrad: bstan pa srung ba'i grogs su 'grogs: mi 'bral yal bar ma dor cig: ces gsungs ma 'ongs don ched du: yi ger bkod nas gter du sbas: smon lam bzhin du 'grub par shog: sa ma ya rgya rgya: sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams nam mkha' mdzod kyi lho phyogs gshin rje'i rba dong nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser shog dril las/ phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i lte ba zla gam dbang chen phug tu gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes bgyis pa sarba siddhi rastu/// /
